resources.string: Shows the day as a status-bar notification, following the device system font without Accessibility Service, overlay, root, or Xposed.
Optionally allow Statusbarplus to bypass battery optimization so the daily update is less likely to be delayed by the system.
Notification permission is required to show the day in the status bar.
Active • using an Android status-bar notification.
Note: SystemUI controls the notification icon position. The size is automatically adapted to the device status-bar scale.

1. Turn on “Show day”.

2. Allow notifications when Android asks. This permission is required because the day/date is displayed as a notification icon in the status bar.

3. Choose the status-bar content and text size. The size is automatically fitted to avoid clipping.

4. If your device often stops background apps, open “Allow background operation” and grant the battery-optimization exemption. This is optional.

The app does not use Accessibility Service, overlays, root, or a continuously running service. It updates when settings change and around the start of a new day.
